package domain

import (
	"regexp"
	"strings"
)

const maxContentSourceKeyLength = 255

var contentSourceKeyPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._:/-]*$`)

// NormalizeContentSourceKey validates a stable external key used by content importers.
// Empty keys remain valid so manually-created legacy content is unaffected.
func NormalizeContentSourceKey(value string) (string, error) {
	key := strings.TrimSpace(value)
	if key == "" {
		return "", nil
	}
	if len(key) > maxContentSourceKeyLength || !contentSourceKeyPattern.MatchString(key) {
		return "", ErrValidation
	}
	for _, segment := range strings.Split(key, "/") {
		if segment == "" || segment == "." || segment == ".." {
			return "", ErrValidation
		}
	}
	return key, nil
}
